symptom: Partial checks could produce an overall safe/export decision
root_cause: Aggregation omitted missing or held checks
acceptance: Inject an omitted required check and prove issued output is blocked.

symptom: Pipeline defaults can fill links, spacings and optional checks
root_cause: Service defaults mix convenience with engineering assumptions
acceptance: Reject unresolved structural inputs or return all profile-resolved values.

symptom: Edited actions/material/depth left prior result associations
root_cause: Result binding did not fully follow effective inputs
acceptance: Change each dependency and prove the old result becomes stale.

symptom: API envelope and frontend result expectations diverged
root_cause: Independently maintained transport contracts
acceptance: Replay one generated contract fixture through both producer and consumer.

symptom: Duplicate editable fields and UI calculations diverged
root_cause: Multiple owners for the same engineering quantity
acceptance: One input owner and one kernel produce every displayed/exported quantity.

symptom: Compression-steel interpolation branch changed outcomes
root_cause: Stress/strain interpolation omitted required branch terms
acceptance: Replay corrected boundary and interior compression-steel cases.

symptom: Deflection depended on an overgeneral support coefficient
root_cause: A label substituted for explicit analysis/load-shape assumptions
acceptance: Different load shapes retain different justified deflection coefficients.

symptom: Flange, lap and torsion applicability produced incorrect outcomes
root_cause: Missing eligibility/minimum checks or capacity capping
acceptance: Compare supported, limiting and unsupported branches without clamping failures to pass.

symptom: Continuous deep-beam steel distribution used the wrong steel basis
root_cause: Required steel substituted for total provided steel
acceptance: Preserve required/provided quantities separately in route-specific cases.

symptom: Sibling routes and consumers bind different source/amendment states
root_cause: Revision ownership is distributed across projects
acceptance: A migration ledger resolves every differing rule/dataset before promotion.

symptom: Area-only bar selection cannot establish buildable detailing
root_cause: The source route intentionally excludes fit and member detailing
acceptance: Check actual bar coordinates, spacing and anchorage before issued detailing.

symptom: A broad architecture and shell plan do not establish installed product behavior
root_cause: Planning, software and installed acceptance are different evidence
acceptance: Load the exact XLL and complete the workbook journey on a clean target.

symptom: Tests ran with stale runtime/source binding
root_cause: Interpreter and current worktree were not aligned
acceptance: Record runtime path, imported source path and delivered candidate identity.

symptom: Generated catalog/manifests omitted changed contracts
root_cause: Hand-maintained projections were not checked with the producer
acceptance: Generate/check projections from the same schema and replay consumers.

symptom: Phase labels and current checkout were misinterpreted
root_cause: Similar plans and machine-local paths were treated as authority
acceptance: Link the controlling packet, repository and revision in each milestone.

symptom: Cross-project agreement can overstate independent verification
root_cause: Implementations may share assumptions, examples or source derivations
acceptance: Classify internal parity separately from independent reference evidence.

symptom: An ETABS read can be mistaken for current design evidence
root_cause: Model, analysis and selected case identity can be decoupled
acceptance: Bind model and result state; require reanalysis after a relevant section change.

symptom: Repeated full gates consumed effort without completing new outcomes
root_cause: Verification cadence was too coarse for bounded changes
acceptance: Focused evidence per change; cumulative assurance once at the named candidate gate.

symptom: 137 library issue titles are repeated automation-alert titles
root_cause: Underlying job causes were not established by the issue index
acceptance: Group alerts by verified cause and link the fixing candidate; investigate logs before claiming a cause.

symptom: Strict schemas may reject supposedly compatible added fields
root_cause: Version policy and unknown-field handling can disagree
acceptance: Run old/new consumer fixtures and require version negotiation for incompatible payloads.
